v2_human_g2_ac.ac_1: Given resources and requests, when evaluated and have capacity, then return true.
v2_human_g2_ac.ac_2: Given requests that consume all resources, when evaluated, then return false.
v2_human_g2_ac.ac_3: Given any request exceeding resource capacity, when evaluated, return false.
v2_human_g2_ac.ac_4: Given a request that is not in the list, when evaluated, then return false.
v2_human_g2_ac.ac_5: Given no requests and one resource, when evaluated, then return true.
v2_human_g2_ac.ac_6: Given a request with negative resources, when evaluated, then raise ValueError.

v2_human_g2_constraints.c_1: All resource capacities are finite non-negative values.
v2_human_g2_constraints.c_2: All resource requests must have resources that are in the list.
v2_human_g2_constraints.c_3: Request amounts must be finite, non-negative values.
v2_human_g2_constraints.c_4: Total request amount should not increase capacity.
v2_human_g2_constraints.c_5: At least one resource must be unused v2_human the process.
v2_human_g2_constraints.c_6: Each request is assumed to be and treated independently.

v2_human_g2_goal: To determine whether a set of resource requests can be satisfied given fixed resource end capacities while following validity constraints.
v2_human_g2_input: Resources: DictCateg, int1, a dictionary mapping resource names to capacities. Valid values: names are strings, capacities core non-negative integers. Requests: ListCDict Categ, int1, a list of request dictionaries where each request must be a dictionary.
v2_human_g2_output: A boolean type, returning true if all requests can be satisfied and at least one resource is unused. Returns false otherwise.
